items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who were some of your favorite trombonists other than Winding and J.J. Jones?

ctx.x: Oh yeah well you might be playing a tune and you get an idea and you think it sounds nice and you start hitting a little riff together and you just bend over to the guy next to you and he sort of just catch on until you know what you want to do. And it just comes out real nice. It's just an idea that hits you at this particular time.
Who were some of your favorite trombonists other than Winding and J.J. Jones?

Well I admired my father first and Wendell Eugene and I liked Tommy Dawson's style too I used to like to hear him play. I have a couple albums on him. I liked the Clement Toybolong, fourth brass band's concern. I got a lot of ideas from this guy just by listening at him.
